posts.description: Bunkering down (Interconnected) Relatively frequently-linked around these parts, Matt Webb has stopped running his own servers, after 27 years, because it's becoming more effort than it's worth. It's certainly something I'm thinking about, and it's really only stubbornness, and the sheer level of faff that it would entail that's stopped me. But it's true that the last couple of personal projects I've put together have used a serverless provider. Tags: security , ai , web
